$comment: Accessory manifests for the character customizer (LANE-UI). The four chains ship skinned to Neck/Spine2 bones — the customizer rebinds them onto the fighter's matching bones by name, so they ride the body. Lanes modeling hair/masks/hoods/gloves/shoes add their own public/models/<category>/manifest.json files in this same shape; the customizer merges every manifest listed in accessories.ts MANIFEST_URLS at runtime.
